zh: 中场休息时我们二比零领先。
en: We were two-nil up at {half time|half-time|halftime}.

zh: 常规时间打平了，所以比赛进入加时赛。
en: It was a draw after ninety minutes, so the game went to {extra time|overtime}.

zh: 最终比分是多少？
en: What was the {final score}?

zh: 这周六我们有一场主场比赛。
en: We've got a {home game|home match} this Saturday.

zh: 她今天跑出了个人最好成绩。
en: She ran a {personal best|PB} today.

zh: 我的健身房会员每个月要六十块。
en: My {gym membership} costs sixty dollars a month.

zh: 裁判在最后一分钟判了一个点球。
en: The referee gave a {penalty kick|penalty} in the last minute.

zh: 你看橄榄球世界杯了吗？
en: Did you watch the Rugby {World Cup}?

zh: 我需要买一双新跑鞋。
en: I need a new pair of {running shoes|runners}.

zh: 跑步前先做一些热身运动。
en: Do some {warm-up exercises|warm up exercises|warm-ups} before you run.

zh: 我买了今年的赛季套票，每场主场比赛都能看。
en: I bought a {season ticket|season pass} this year, so I can go to every home match.

zh: 他因为一次危险的铲球吃了红牌。
en: He got a {red card} for a dangerous tackle.

zh: 我每周去游泳池两次。
en: I go to the {swimming pool|pool} twice a week.

zh: 他们在伤停补时阶段进了一球。
en: They scored in {injury time|stoppage time|added time}.

zh: 我请了一位私人教练帮我减肥。
en: I've hired a {personal trainer} to help me lose weight.

zh: 今晚的训练课因为下雨取消了。
en: Tonight's {training session|practice session} has been cancelled because of the rain.

zh: 他打破了一百米的世界纪录。
en: He broke the {world record} for the hundred metres.

zh: 我更喜欢团队运动，比如足球。
en: I prefer {team sports}, like football.

zh: 在自己的场地比赛会有主场优势。
en: Playing at your own ground gives you {home advantage|home-field advantage|home ground advantage}.

zh: 周末我骑山地车进了树林。
en: I took my {mountain bike} into the forest at the weekend.

zh: 决赛是通过点球大战决出胜负的。
en: The final was decided by a {penalty shootout|penalty shoot-out}.

zh: 明天是我的休息日，不训练。
en: Tomorrow is my {rest day|day off}, so no training.

zh: 教练总是强调公平竞赛。
en: The coach always talks about {fair play}.

zh: 夏天我们下班后打触式橄榄球。
en: In summer we play {touch rugby|touch} after work.

zh: 上半场我们踢得很差。
en: We played badly in the {first half}.

zh: 两队积分相同，但我们的净胜球更多。
en: Both teams have the same points, but we have a better {goal difference|goal differential}.

zh: 他这周没进首发阵容。
en: He isn't in the {starting line-up|starting lineup|starting eleven} this week.

zh: 记得带上你的瑜伽垫。
en: Remember to bring your {yoga mat}.

zh: 我们队现在排在联赛积分榜的第一位。
en: Our team is top of the {league table|ladder|standings} at the moment.

zh: 训练时别忘了带水壶。
en: Don't forget your {water bottle|drink bottle} for training.
